mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spot WHERE status = 1 AND type != 2) AS spot_on_sale, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM spot WHERE status = 0 AND type != 2) AS spot_offline, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkin_log) AS checkin_total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM checkin_log WHERE checkin_time >= #{todayStart}) AS checkin_today, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reserve WHERE status = 0) AS reserve_pending
